mapper.select: SELECT id,title,content,status,published_at,created_at,updated_at FROM notices status=#{status} ORDER BY COALESCE(published_at,created_at) DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE notices SET title=#{title},content=#{content} WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('DRAFT','WITHDRAWN')
UPDATE notices SET status='PUBLISHED',published_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),publisher_id=#{actor} WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('DRAFT','WITHDRAWN')
UPDATE notices SET status='WITHDRAWN' WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PUBLISHED'
